issues.message: While this page waited for its data (GET /orders.json; renderlint held it 1s, as on a slow network), the area where "Order · Customer · Total · Status" appears showed nothing: no spinner, skeleton, progress bar or "Loading…" text. On a slow connection the page looks empty or frozen. Render a loading state in #orders until the data arrives (a skeleton shaped like the content, or a spinner), and an error message if the request fails.
